WITH site_rates AS (
  SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM site_rates
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT sr.avg_rate, b.benchmark_rate
  FROM site_rates sr
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE sr.avg_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(avg_rate - benchmark_rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
